answer: Unrepeatable Challenge Sampling. Each identity must answer fresh challenges drawn from a public entropy beacon; answers embed a per-epoch nonce, so reuse fails verification. Registration demands solving one random challenge whose output must hit a quartz-derived difficulty target, resetting at the economic nadir of each cycle. A single lotus-shaped commitment seals the answer to that identity only. Attackers pay full compute per identity per epoch, making mass fabrication cost scale linearly with fleet size.
